prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while turning left at an intersection. The patient reported immediate pain in the right shoulder with limited range of motion and difficulty lifting the arm overhead. Physical examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and mild weakness with resisted movement. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture, with findings consistent with a soft tissue strain of the rotator cuff and periscapular muscles.

Treatment over the course of 11 visits included manual therapy, progressive therapeutic exercise targeting scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening, and modalities for pain control. A home exercise program was taught and reinforced at each session. The patient's pain decreased steadily, range of motion improved to near-normal limits, and strength returned to functional levels by the final visit.

At discharge the patient was independent with daily activities and work duties, with occasional mild discomfort after prolonged overhead use. Continued self-directed home exercise was recommended, with follow-up on an as-needed basis should symptoms recur.
